original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.

actual_scope: Conditional rank-one child tariff for the 56 plane translations left unpriced in PR1825, using its 9 rank-7 and 7 rank-9 mixed query profile, two data-shrink brackets and exact complex packing relaxation.
scope_change_reason: The chosen helper-inventory card is heavily covered, and PR1825 introduces a new plane-port boundary with an explicitly open translation cost. This audits that cost with an optimistic fully charged child histogram instead of constructing a new helper.
bottleneck_link: The complex side binds the selected endpoint; a two-unpaid-coordinate plane-port decoder only helps if its copied information and 56 translations fit the recursive moment.
stop_rule: Stop after exact thresholds for the selected endpoint, selected-word ceiling and +10% kappa under both data-shrink brackets; do not claim a forced translation tariff or a complete hosted route.
evidence: RESULT.json: maximum extra rank-one calls 37/38 at selected endpoint and selected-word cap, 33/35 at +10% kappa; all direct 56-child moments >1; exact intervals and threshold+1 controls; equals PR1808's all-rank-1 copy budget minus 126 to within one unit; PR1825 zero-tariff a_hi reproduced.
author: Josie Elliston
ai_assistance: Substantial: OpenAI Codex (offline session 22) chose the conditional tariff, derived and implemented the exact screen, and drafted the documentation; Claude (Anthropic, Claude Code) reviewed it against live PR1825/PR1808/PR1889, added the PR1825 anchor and PR1808 comparison checks, and narrowed the claims. No independent human review.

open_questions.question: Are PR1825's plane translations free in a hosted plane-port route, as the line-port terminal translation X_q is?
open_questions.why_it_matters: If not, at least 18-23 of 56 must avoid separate rank-one calls under the direct tariff; if so, the 33-38 units of slack remain for frames, hosting and restoration.
open_questions.first_step: Repair the scalar endpoint rejected by PR1889, then extract the literal plane schedule and test whether translations fold into the terminal frame.
open_questions.blocked_by: No complete hosted route, frame schedule or certified scalar decoder for the C=126 profile.

open_questions.question: Does the bit side leave room for the same per-call overhead?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A complex-only gain eventually leaves the bit supplier binding.
open_questions.first_step: Apply PR1808's bit-side budget to open PR1900's five-plane P111 bit decoder including its translation and frame tariff.
open_questions.blocked_by: No joint assembly of the complex and bit plane-port decoders.
